description: Compiler infers unsafe boundaries from SKB rules in agent mode
rationale: Agent mode elides `unsafe` blocks; the compiler uses OWN/BOR/FFI rules to verify safety

description: Compiler marks functions as unsafe internally based on body analysis
rationale: Agent mode does not require `unsafe fn` — the compiler detects FFI calls, raw pointer ops, and union access

description: Compiler infers all lifetime annotations in agent mode
rationale: Explicit lifetime annotations are elided; the compiler's LIF rules resolve all borrows

description: Compiler infers &mut from usage context in agent mode
rationale: &T vs &mut T is determined by the compiler from write operations on the reference

description: Compiler derives Send/Sync bounds automatically in agent mode
rationale: Send and Sync bounds are inferred from type structure; no explicit annotations needed

description: Compiler infers move vs borrow capture for closures in agent mode
rationale: The `move` keyword is unnecessary; compiler determines capture mode from usage

description: Compiler handles Pin<T> wrapping for self-referential types
rationale: Pin requirements are detected and enforced without explicit syntax

description: Compiler chooses between static and dynamic dispatch automatically
rationale: No `dyn`/`impl` distinction needed — compiler selects based on call site analysis

description: Borrow checker runs post-hoc in agent mode, not as syntax constraint
rationale: Agent code is accepted without explicit borrow annotations; violations detected as compiler diagnostics

description: Runtime bounds checks may be elided when compiler proves safety
rationale: Index operations skip bounds checks when the compiler can prove the index is in range

description: Arithmetic overflow checks elided when compiler proves no overflow
rationale: Agent mode skips overflow checks for operations proved to be in range

description: PhantomData<T> fields inserted automatically by compiler
rationale: Variance and drop-check markers handled internally without explicit PhantomData

description: `.await` compressed to `.w` in agent mode syntax
rationale: Agent mode minimizes token count; `.w` is a 4-character saving per await point

description: `return` compressed to `ret` in agent mode syntax
rationale: Agent mode uses `ret` for 3-character saving per return statement

description: `effect` compressed to `fx` in agent mode syntax
rationale: Agent mode uses `fx` for 4-character saving per effect declaration

description: `handle` compressed to `hx` in agent mode syntax
rationale: Agent mode uses `hx` for 4-character saving per handler

description: `spec` compressed to `sp` in agent mode syntax
rationale: Agent mode uses `sp` for 2-character saving per spec block

description: `extern` compressed to `xn` in agent mode syntax
rationale: Agent mode uses `xn` for 4-character saving per extern block

description: `yield` compressed to `yl` in agent mode syntax
rationale: Agent mode uses `yl` for 3-character saving per yield expression

description: Unsafe op detected — SKB rules OWN/BOR/FFI provide compile-time verification
rationale: The compiler cross-references unsafe operations against SKB rules to verify correctness without language-level `unsafe` syntax
fix_template: Verify operation is covered by existing SKB rule; if not, add a new AEL rule

description: Raw pointer operations (*const T, *mut T) verified via SKB without `unsafe` block
rationale: The compiler detects raw pointer dereferences and verifies alignment, validity, and aliasing via FFI and OWN rules

description: Union field access verified via type rules without `unsafe` block
rationale: The compiler ensures discriminant is checked before union field access

description: Mutable static access verified via concurrency rules without `unsafe` block
rationale: The compiler ensures mutable statics are only accessed under proper synchronization

description: Extern function calls verified via FFI rules without `unsafe` block
rationale: The compiler validates argument types, nullable pointers, and calling conventions for extern calls

description: Transmute operations verified via type layout rules without `unsafe` block
rationale: The compiler ensures size, alignment, and validity invariants hold for transmutations
fix_template: Verify source and target types have compatible layouts

description: Inline assembly verified via platform rules without `unsafe` block
rationale: The compiler validates register constraints and side effects for inline asm

description: AI construct keywords compressed to Greek symbols in agent mode
rationale: net→Ψ, layer→λ, tensor→Φ, train→Θ, agent→α, kb→κ, evolve→Ω enable 3-5× density

description: Type constructors compressed to sigils in agent mode
rationale: Box→^, Rc→$, Arc→@, Mutex→#, Vec→[]~, Option→?, Result→R[] enable compact type expressions

description: Control flow keywords compressed to operators in agent mode
rationale: if→?, else→:, for→@, loop→@@, break→!, continue→>>, match→?= minimize control flow tokens

description: Declaration keywords compressed to single characters in agent mode
rationale: fn→f, let→v, let mut→m, struct→S, enum→E, trait→T, impl→I, mod→M, use→u, pub→+
